conviction_note: Two forces of similar size pull in opposite directions. The first: King Jim is one of JPX's 683 TOPIX transition names, and its first 12.5% weight cut trades at the 10-29 close. That is the entry price, so the mechanical selling ends just as the window opens. The second: the company has cut its H1 forecast at 3 of its last 4 Q1 prints, and the H1 revenue guide (+7.4%) is ambitious. abs_move 2.0 rests on the name's own Q1-print reactions (-4.26, -3.13, +0.12, -1.19), not on the 0.94 proxy. p_up is 52, a slight tilt toward the documented flow reversal. impact_sum (+0.3) and impact_scaled (+0.08) agree in sign and both are near zero.
bar: The company's own H1 FY2027 guide, published 2026-07-30: revenue 19,300m JPY (+7.4%), operating profit 200m, ordinary profit 385m, net 200m. Full-year guide: revenue 42,000m, operating profit 1,440m (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260730503307.pdf). No IFIS or Shikiho number could be sourced, so the bar is company-only and every finding that depends on it is capped small. print_vs_bar is on revenue: an estimated Q1 shortfall against a pro-rata H1 path, given that the company missed its last revenue guide by 7% (42,000 to 39,134).
positioning_check: JPX short register as of 2026-10-28: no disclosed position at or above 0.5% (0.0%, no change) (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Margin ratio (信用倍率) is 0.19, so margin shorts outweigh margin longs about five to one; this is a squeeze setup on a positive release. There is no option skew in this market. The tape shows a -4.4% slide from 770 (10-23) to 736 at the seal, on volume of 81.6k and 122.2k shares on 10-27 and 10-28 against roughly 25-30k normal. That pattern fits pre-positioning ahead of the TOPIX transition sale at the 10-29 close. The same days TOPIX ETF 1306 was flat (418.4 to 420.7), and peers fell less: Kokuyo -2.8% on 10-28 and Pilot -1.6% (Yahoo chart, 2026-10-29).

findings.finding: King Jim (7962) is No. 536 on JPX's list of 683 TOPIX transition names (移行措置銘柄), so its index weight falls to 0.875 at the first periodic review. Index funds trade that cut at the 10-29 close, which is this window's entry price. At about 12.5% of passive holdings, against a float market cap of roughly 12-15bn JPY and median turnover of 24m JPY a day, the sale is many days of normal volume, and it is finished when the window opens.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name has no prior index-deletion event. The run-in to this one is -4.4% in four sessions on 3-4x normal volume (10-27 81.6k, 10-28 122.2k shares) while TOPIX was flat. The general pattern for index deletions is temporary price pressure that partly reverses after the effective close.
findings.why_not_priced: The list is public, so the selling itself is priced: the 4-5% slide on heavy volume is the evidence. The window, however, starts AFTER the closing-auction sale. If the market had already absorbed the flow, the price would not have dropped on 3-4x volume in the two days before the sale while TOPIX was flat. What is left for this window is the reversal once a dated seller is done, which no fundamental holder is positioned for on a thinly covered name. The remaining seven quarterly steps fall outside the window.
findings.independence: The timing (rebalance on the 10-29 close, effective 10-30) comes from a separate source, Monex (https://media.monex.co.jp/articles/-/30310, 2026). The volume and price run-in come from the Yahoo chart (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/7962.T?range=5y&interval=1d).

findings.finding: King Jim revised its H1 forecast at 3 of its last 4 Q1 prints. In 2022-11-01, 2023-10-31 and 2025-10-31 the H1 forecast was revised, and the last two were cuts (2025: H1 ordinary profit 400m to 370m, on weak TEPRA and lifestyle sales). This year's H1 guide asks for revenue +7.4% after FY26 revenue fell 1.3%, the company missed its own 42,000m revenue guide by about 7%, and on 2026-07-30 it cut the medium-term plan because the M&A did not close and furniture subsidiary ぼん家具 stayed weak.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Next-session moves after Q1 prints: 2022-11-02 -4.26% (H1 revised), 2023-11-01 -3.13% (H1 cut), 2024-11-05 +0.12% (no revision), 2025-11-04 -1.19% (H1 cut 7.5%, FY held). The 2026-01-26 full-year cut drew -1.10%.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing has been pre-released: TDnet shows no 業績予想の修正 for 7962 from 10-14 through 10-28. There is no IFIS or Shikiho bar I could confirm, so nobody visibly marks the guide down. If the market had priced a cut, the slide would have shown up before the index-flow days, and it did not: the stock drifted from 803 to 770 over September-October, in line with peers. The size is capped small because the bar is unsourced and because the reasoning rests on company habit, not on a number.
findings.independence: The 2025 Q1 revision text comes from a separate document: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7962&b=k202510310295 (2025-10-31). The medium-term plan cut: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260730503573.pdf (2026-07-30).

findings.finding: Q1 FY27 (Jun 21 to Sep 20, 2026) is the first Q1 to carry a full quarter of the 2025-09-22 price revision, which the base quarter did not have. It also carries a second revision on stationery and some electronics, effective 2026-08-21 and announced 2026-06-22, which gave distributors about two months to buy ahead inside the quarter. The FY26 短信 credits price revisions for the gross-margin gains that took Q4 FY26 operating profit to 606m from 151m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the Q4 FY26 margin print (released 2026-07-30, op 4.0x year on year) the stock moved -1.0% the next session, but that was after a 2026-07-23 pre-release that moved it +1.14%. The beat had already been pre-released.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly inside the guide: the company set the H1 plan on 2026-07-30 knowing about both hikes, so this finding is held near zero. What may not be priced is the Q1 headline. Kabutan leads with Q1 ordinary profit, which was a 135m loss last year. A clearly narrower loss reads well to the retail register, and the 0.19 margin ratio means shorts would have to cover into it.
findings.independence: The FY26 短信 attributes margin gains to price revisions: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260730503307.pdf (2026-07-30).

findings.finding: On 2026-06-23, two days into Q1, fire broke out at King Jim's Tokyo logistics center (third-party operated, 信濃運輸 葛西流通センター). Shipping was partly halted until full resumption on 2026-07-01. This means some lost Q1 sales and possibly a one-off fire loss, but the 2026-07-30 短信 lists no material subsequent event (重要な後発事象: 該当事項なし).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior incident like this in the baseline.
findings.why_not_priced: The fire was disclosed only on the company's product-news page, not on TDnet, so a Q1 extraordinary-loss line would be new to most holders. The company judged it immaterial at 7-30, so it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: The first and second fire reports: https://www.kingjim.co.jp/news/detail/834.html and https://www.kingjim.co.jp/news/detail/835.html (2026-06-23). The 短信's subsequent-events note: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260730503307.pdf

outside_window.finding: TOPIX transition steps 2-8 (a further 12.5% weight cut each quarter to 2028-07, with re-evaluation in 2027-10) mean more passive supply, on dates after this window.

searched_and_found_nothing: TDnet daily lists 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-28, all pages: no 業績予想の修正, 配当予想の修正 or 自己株式取得 for 7962. The only item was the 10-14 stock-remuneration treasury disposal.
TDnet 2026-10-29 pages 001-010 (at 10:28 JST): the release is not out yet.

Shareholder returns: no buyback or dividend change at any of the last four Q1 prints. The dividend policy is a 40%+ payout, 15 JPY planned (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260730503307.pdf).
IFIS consensus or 会社四季報 forecast for 7962: not reachable, so the bar is company-only.
Yahoo!ファイナンス board for 7962: HTTP 500.

Corporate-site emergency maintenance 10-22 to 10-26 and the TEPRA 'Hello' app server outage 10-23 to 10-27 (https://www.kingjim.co.jp/news/detail/871.html): the company says it found no unauthorized access, and the incident falls after Q1. It does not bear on this print.
E-store ショップサーブ breach (https://www.kingjim.co.jp/news/detail/858.html, 2026-09-04): it concerns a legacy EC customer list and has no P&L line in Q1.

The 2026-08-31 notice on repairs in 災害救助法 areas is a standing generic policy, not tied to a specific disaster or a demand spike.
release_time_source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7962&b=n202610281205 (2026-10-28 schedule: 'King Jim Q1, after the close'). Every 7962 release for two years has been stamped 16:00, for example https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7962&b=k202510310295
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: plausible. 3 of the last 4 Q1 prints carried an H1 revision, the last two down, and nothing has been pre-released this year. Returns: none expected; there is no history of returns at Q1 and the dividend is set at 15 JPY. New-year guide: not applicable at Q1. Quarter: Q1 is the seasonal loss quarter (op -252m in FY25, -213m in FY26), so 進捗率 against the H1 op guide of 200m is meaningless. The real question is whether the loss narrows year on year on price revisions.
baseline_tension: The baseline lean is +0.68, from the margin-short overhang and the negative run-up. My largest finding agrees with it, and I attribute the run-up to dated index flow, not to informed selling. The strongest positive the release could carry is a narrower Q1 loss on the price revisions with the H1 guide held, against a 0.19 margin ratio. I looked for it, and it is filed at +0.3. It is weighed against the company's habit of cutting H1 at Q1, which the market can see.
lessons_applied: nothing changed. Rule 1 (a negative that rests on a public series means p_up toward 50) applies only partly: the guidance finding rests on a possible forecast cut ADDED by the release, not on a visible 月次 miss. Its size was already capped, and p_up is already near 50. Rule 2 (check the sign): two positives and two negatives, and the strongest positive (a narrower Q1 loss with the guide held) was searched for and filed.
